title: IPU Lab
text: How do we infer others’ traits and mental states such as their thoughts and feelings? We study the accuracy and biases of these inferences, what shapes them (e.g., the cues available, characteristics of perceivers and targets, communication context), the social-cognitive mechanisms behind them, and their consequences.

title: Two Lines of Research
text:
Empathic accuracy
How well do people infer what others are thinking and feeling?
Empathic accuracy is the ability to correctly infer another person’s thoughts and feelings. We study how well people do this in everyday interactions, what makes some perceivers and some targets easier to read, and how it relates to other forms of social understanding.

title: Two Lines of Research
text:
Perspective-taking
Does trying to see through someone else’s eyes actually help us understand them?
People often try to take others’ perspectives, but these efforts do not always improve understanding. We investigate when perspective-taking leads to better insight into others, and when it mostly increases confidence.

title: Two Lines of Research
text:
Screens, AI & morality
What changes when we perceive and understand others through a screen, or through an AI?
Much of social life now happens over video calls, text, and increasingly in conversation with large language models. We examine how these channels change the cues available about others, how AI systems judge people and how people judge AI, and what this means for empathy, fairness, moral judgment, and trust.

title: IPU Lab
text:
Research themes


Perception

Interpersonal perception
How accurately do we judge others’ personalities, and how much of what we see in them is really ourselves?



Understanding

Thought-feeling (Empathic) accuracy
How well do people infer what others are thinking and feeling, and what makes some perceivers better at it?



Understanding

Perspective-taking
When does trying to see through another’s eyes improve understanding, and when does it mostly boost confidence?



Across contexts

Screens, AI & morality
How video, text, and large language models change what we perceive and understand about others, and how we judge them.

title: IPU Lab
text:
Interpersonal Understanding
What happens when we try to see the world through someone else’s eyes? We study when and why people take others’ perspectives, how well they succeed, and how doing so shapes downstream outcomes such as moral judgments and prosocial behavior. We are also interested in the limits of perspective taking and in ways to help people understand one another better.
